decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east or west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until details of lead flashing, method of capping, method of fixing zinc cladding, and details of the proposed roof drainage have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
